role_card.question: What needs my attention and what can I do next?
role_card.decision_object: Current-state summary with one contextual next action

compositions.anatomy: Current state, time/context and action share a compact ticket; supporting shortcuts form a quieter group.
compositions.mobile: Keep labels, state and action together; preserve reading order at narrow widths.

compositions.anatomy: A chronological activity spine leads, with the next actionable event expanded.
compositions.mobile: Use reachable controls and reflow without shrinking essential type.

role_card.density: Working hypothesis: compact within one decision, breathing room between unrelated tasks. Inspect real text and enlarged text.
role_card.reject_when: Decorative hero displaces the next useful action.

type_selection: Choose productive vs expressive roles from the current task, not the website label alone.
Choose font by actual glyph coverage, legibility, numerals, weight availability, license and subject/brand fit. No prescribed family.
Measure headline wraps and first decision-object position; a large clamp value is not a hierarchy proof.
Set body, UI and metadata independently. Do not shrink explanatory body copy to fit a dense object.
spacing_selection: Separate page gutters, section rhythm, group gaps and component padding.
Use tighter spacing within one decision object than between unrelated decisions.
Try a denser and a more expressive arrangement when density is a free axis; choose from real content and media.
Use a repeated base only when it helps alignment; optical exceptions need a reason.
art_direction: Specify subject, view distance, detail level, lighting, safe crop zone, caption and mobile treatment.
Choose document, product, person, place or process media for the information it conveys.
Use one icon family with visible labels; technical appearance alone is not evidence.
Reserve one memorable visual commitment tied to subject matter; do not stack unrelated effects.
tone_of_voice: Use concrete nouns, actions and outputs. State what the buyer can evaluate or do next.
Prefer one useful explanation to repeated brand adjectives or vague benefit slogans.
Separate actual evidence, design concepts and unknown capabilities.
Do not reproduce the vocabulary, numerical claims or identity of a reference supplier.
pressure_checks: longest real heading and service name
one primary CTA visible and named

reflow.principle: Check information and function at 320 CSS px; handle genuinely two-dimensional content separately.

reference_anatomy.rule: No exact profile/page-role card is a visible knowledge gap. Research the current first-party page and author a grounded transfer; never borrow an unrelated industry preset.

factory_design_knowledge.rule: Cards and ranges are candidates, not a preset or exhaustive catalog. Create another grounded composition when these examples do not fit. Choose from real content, constraints and renders; do not adopt lexical upstream matches as project truth.

factory_retrieval_review.next_action: Verify product/category and page-role fit; record ADOPT / ADAPT / REJECT in the project Design Contract. A fallback is not domain-specific knowledge.
